Name: UPDATED Long Haired Penny- Content Pack version
Author: blamethestxrs
Description:
This mod is pretty simple, it basically just changes penny to have long hair in the game in the style shown in the images.

However! This is a content patcher version that aedenthorn put together, and so it doesn't require you editing your .xnb files (so I recommend downloading this mod instead of my other one). 

I made this mod because I couldn't find any versions of penny w/long hair that I liked. So, if you want penny to have her hair down/long, here's a mod for it! new and improved to where you don't have to edit your game files! hope people enjoy, and props to aedenthorn for converting my xnb mod to this!

Downloads.DisplayName: Long Haired Penny for Content Patcher
Downloads.FileName: Long Haired Penny for Content Patcher-6588-1-0-1596765776.zip
Downloads.Description: This is a content patcher file that will change penny's sprite and portrait appearance to the one I designed. As long as you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed, just download this and put it in your mods folder and you should be good to go
